page.layout: Two parallel columns of German words (left) and Latin equivalents (right), in the upper half; below them one paragraph running full width; then a second pair of parallel columns of the same kind.

main_text.p: Kna-ven tag erat illi, Bonus dies. Nam Kna-ven; Bonum dicebat: & pleraque alia cum nostrâ lingua non satis congruentia usurpa-bat, &c.

page.notes: Ink blot over the left column of the lower list, near "Iel uburt" and "Marz us"; some words there are doubtful. Faint show-through of the reverse side is present and omitted. Words marked [?] are uncertain because of the blot, the worn type, and the broken letters in the German column. The long s is printed as a plain s, and the initial "Vita, five" is read as "sive".
